name: Bug report

**What happened**
A clear description of the bug.

**What you expected**
What you expected to happen instead.

**Which run**
Link to the GitHub Actions run (or paste the relevant log lines). Please
redact any secret values — though the pipeline masks them by default.

**Mode**
Which mode was running: daily / week / health / channels / cloudinary / models.

**Anything else**
Extra context, screenshots, etc.
